name: For over an Iterator yielding nil

input.source_text: let mut log = []; let mut n = 0; class It { public fun next() { n = n + 1; if n == 1 { Iteration.yield(nil) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { log.append(:closed); nil } } class Src { public fun iterator() { It.new() } } for x in Src.new() { log.append(:body) }; log

applicability.reason: Pure Iris iteration source has no native boundary.
